enriched_activities.desc: Lies down in bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Turns to right side. Moves arm under pillow. Remains still. Breathes deeply. Turns again. Stretches leg. Curls up. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Turns on bathroom light. Turns on tap. Wets hands. Picks up soap. Rubs hands together. Applies soap to face. Rinses face. Turns off tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Wipes face with towel. Turns off light.

Enters kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs, milk, bread. Closes refrigerator. Cracks eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turns on stove. Pours eggs into pan. Cooks eggs. Turns off stove. Places eggs on plate. Toasts bread. Pours milk into glass. Sits at table. Eats breakfast. Drinks milk. Picks up plate. Puts plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and checking the day's client visit list on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt. Takes out pants. Closes wardrobe. Takes off pajamas. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens calendar app. Scrolls through list. Reads client names. Checks addresses. Puts phone in pocket. Picks up bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the community health centre
enriched_activities.desc: Walks out of house. Locks door. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Checks phone. Gets off bus. Walks to health centre. Enters building.

enriched_activities.activity: Conducting community health outreach visits and health checks for residents
enriched_activities.desc: Arrives at first client's home. Knocks on door. Greets client: 'Hello, how are you feeling today?' Enters home. Asks about health. Measures blood pressure. Checks temperature. Listens to lungs. Records notes. Advises on medication. Says goodbye. Walks to next client. Knocks on door. Enters. Greets. Measures blood pressure. Records. Checks medication. Advises. Leaves.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the health centre
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to cafe. Enters cafe. Orders food. Pays. Waits. Receives food. Finds table. Sits down. Unwraps sandwich. Takes bite. Chews. Swallows. Drinks water. Wipes mouth. Throws trash. Stands up. Walks back to health centre.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing home visits and follow-up consultations with clients
enriched_activities.desc: Knocks on door. Enters. Greets. Asks about symptoms. Measures blood pressure. Checks wound. Changes bandage. Records notes. Advises on diet. Schedules next visit. Says goodbye. Walks to next client. Knocks on door. Enters. Greets. Measures blood pressure. Records. Checks medication. Advises. Leaves.
Walks to bus stop. Waits. Boards bus. Pays. Sits. Checks phone. Gets off bus. Walks home. Unlocks door. Enters. Closes door. Locks door.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into comfortable clothes and logging case notes on computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Takes off shoes. Takes off work clothes. Puts on t-shirt. Puts on sweatpants. Walks to desk. Turns on computer. Waits for boot. Opens case notes file. Types notes. Saves file. Closes computer. Stands up.

Enters kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Closes refrigerator. Washes vegetables. Cuts vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Adds oil. Adds vegetables. Stirs. Adds spices. Turns off stove. Places food on plate. Sits at table. Eats. Drinks water. Picks up plate. Puts in sink.

Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Takes off clothes. Turns on shower. Steps into shower. Washes body. Washes hair. Rinses. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Puts on clean clothes. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing client files and planning tomorrow's schedule on computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Opens client files. Reads. Takes notes. Opens calendar. Schedules appointments. Checks email. Closes files. Turns off computer. Stands up.

Walks to living room. Turns on TV. Picks up remote. Sits on couch. Changes channel. Watches TV. Adjusts volume. Changes channel again. Watches more. Picks up phone. Checks phone. Puts phone down. Stretches. Yawns. Turns off TV. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a warm drink and preparing items for the next day
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Turns on light. Opens cabinet. Takes out mug. Closes cabinet. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk. Closes refrigerator. Pours milk into mug. Places mug in microwave. Turns on microwave. Takes out mug. Stirs. Drinks. Washes mug. Puts mug in rack. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom. Prepares clothes for next day. Packs bag.

Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes. Washes hands. Turns on tap. Wets toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Dries face. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading on phone briefly and sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens reading app. Scrolls. Reads. Turns page. Reads more. Puts phone on nightstand. Turns off lamp. Closes eyes. Turns to side. Pulls blanket. Breathes slowly. Falls asleep.
